# OpenLintel

> AI-assisted design exploration, drawings, and material planning for residential design professionals. Follow one room from brief to sample handoff.

Educational guides and free editable templates for residential interior design studios, plus an illustrative sample project. Resources are drafted with AI assistance and have not received independent professional review; where a page shows an AI-assisted editorial check, that check is dated on the page. They are not legal, construction, or engineering documents.

## Templates

- [Interior design client questionnaire (Word)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-client-questionnaire/): Download an editable interior design client questionnaire with a worked example, discovery questions, and guidance for turning answers into a brief.
- [Interior design brief template (Word)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-brief/): An editable residential interior design brief with objectives, constraints, priorities, decisions, and a clearly labeled Window Room example.
- [Interior design proposal template (Word)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-proposal/): Create a clear interior design proposal with an editable DOCX outline, sample project narrative, deliverables, assumptions, and next steps.
- [Interior design scope of work template (Word)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-scope-of-work/): Define interior design deliverables, responsibilities, exclusions, and review checkpoints with an editable scope-of-work planning template.
- [Interior design budget template (Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-budget/): Download an editable interior design budget spreadsheet with working totals, variance formulas, a blank sheet, and an illustrative worked example.
- [Interior design spec sheet template (specification sheet, Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-spec-sheet/): Download an editable interior design specification sheet with product references, dimensions, supplier fields, approval status, and a worked example.
- [FF&E schedule template (Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/ffe-schedule/): An editable furniture, fixtures, and equipment schedule with room references, quantities, specification links, and delivery-review fields.
- [Finish schedule template (Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/finish-schedule/): Download a room finish schedule spreadsheet connecting floors, walls, and other surfaces to finish references, quantities, and review notes.
- [Room data sheet template (Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/room-data-sheet/): Keep room dimensions, functional requirements, finishes, source references, and unresolved information together in an editable room data sheet.
- [Interior design project timeline template (Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-project-timeline/): An editable interior design phase planner with owners, dates, dependencies, review milestones, and a worked example without invented deadlines.
- [Interior design site survey checklist (Word)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-site-survey-checklist/): An editable interior design site-survey checklist for dimensions, openings, visible conditions, photo references, and follow-up information.
- [Interior design presentation templates (PPTX and DOCX)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-presentation/): Download editable PowerPoint slides, a DOCX storyboard, and a PDF preview with composed mood boards, design rationale, and an illustrative room example.
- [Interior design purchase order planning template (Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/interior-design-purchase-order/): Educational workbook and PDF preview connecting selections, quotes, delivery dates and purchasing authority. Pending practitioner review.
- [Residential plumbing fixture schedule template (Excel)](https://openlintel.com/templates/plumbing-fixture-schedule/): Educational workbook and PDF preview for residential fixture selections, product sources, coordination questions and review responsibility. Pending practitioner review.

## Guides

- [Interior design mood board examples](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-mood-board-examples/): Explore two annotated interior design mood boards for one illustrative room, with palette decisions, material references, and a client-review checklist.
- [How to make an interior design material board](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-material-board/): Connect material samples to finish references, applications, and approvals with a practical material-board guide and an illustrative palette.
- [Interior design concept boards: from brief to direction](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-concept-board/): Develop a concept board that explains your design idea, distinguishes mood from materials, and makes client review more focused.
- [Interior design space planning: a practical workflow](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-space-planning/): Work through room uses, fixed constraints, furniture relationships, and circulation with an annotated illustrative floor plan and review checklist.
- [How to measure a room for interior design](https://openlintel.com/resources/how-to-measure-a-room/): Record room dimensions, openings, diagonals, and photo references clearly, with a practical measurement workflow and editable survey checklist.
- [The interior design process, from brief to handoff](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-process/): Understand interior design phases through their inputs, deliverables, review decisions, and a connected set of editable professional resources.
- [Interior design procurement: a coordination guide](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-procurement/): Follow selections from approval through supplier confirmation, ordering, delivery, substitutions, and receiving records without losing the design references.
- [How to read interior elevation drawings](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-elevation-drawings/): Read an illustrative joinery elevation through its view reference, dimensions, material notes, and relationship to the plan and specification.
- [What is a reflected ceiling plan?](https://openlintel.com/resources/reflected-ceiling-plan/): Learn how to read a reflected ceiling plan, its orientation and legend, and the coordination questions it raises through an illustrative teaching diagram.
- [What is FF&E in interior design? Meaning, examples, and schedules](https://openlintel.com/resources/ffe-in-interior-design/): FF&E means furniture, fixtures, and equipment. Learn what it covers in interior design, how it differs from OS&E and finishes, and how a schedule and spec sheet connect.
- [Interior design project management: phases, approvals, and handoff](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-project-management/): How interior design project management works across phases: decision owners, the approvals that apply, and a handoff with a usable revision trail. Editable timeline included.
- [Interior design drawings: the full set and a drawing checklist](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-drawing-checklist/): Which drawings make up an interior design package, from furnished plans to elevations and reflected ceiling plans, plus a checklist for references, units, and revisions.
- [AI concept images vs. dimensioned design documentation](https://openlintel.com/resources/ai-concept-images-vs-design-documentation/): Use an annotated room example to distinguish visual intent, dimensioned drawings, sourced product information, and decisions that still need review.
- [From a residential design brief to coordinated schedules](https://openlintel.com/resources/brief-to-coordinated-schedules/): Follow F-01 seating, J-01 joinery, and FIN-02 walls from brief requirements into plans, specifications, FF&E, and finish schedules without duplicating authority.
- [Managing an interior design specification change](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-specification-change/): Work through a proposed F-01 sofa change with a before-and-after record, impact table, approval boundaries, and a coordinated issue checklist.
- [What belongs in an interior design handoff package?](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-handoff-package/): Build an identifiable issue index with document purpose, revisions, recipients, responsibilities, and open questions using the illustrative Window Room package.
- [Client approval, technical review, and purchasing approval](https://openlintel.com/resources/interior-design-approval-states/): Distinguish visual selection, project-specific technical review, and purchasing authority with a sample approval matrix and precise decision-record examples.
- [How to evaluate AI interior design software for a studio](https://openlintel.com/resources/evaluating-ai-interior-design-software/): Run a practical, evidence-based studio software evaluation covering one room, source records, a controlled change, exports, review boundaries, and client-data handling.

- [AI-assisted interior design workflows](https://openlintel.com/): AI-assisted design exploration, drawings, and material planning for residential design professionals. Follow one room from brief to sample handoff.
- [How OpenLintel works: design, drawings & materials](https://openlintel.com/how-it-works/): Explore an illustrative OpenLintel workflow connecting room information, concepts, drawings, and materials. Software is in active development; professional review is required.

- [Interior design workflows for residential studios](https://openlintel.com/for-design-studios/): Explore editable resources and an illustrative connected workflow for residential design studios. OpenLintel is in active development.
- [Interior design coordination for architects](https://openlintel.com/for-architects/): Develop and communicate interior spatial intent through room information, design options, plans, elevations, and material references.
- [Open-source interior design software](https://openlintel.com/open-source/): Explore OpenLintel’s open-source interior design software, setup requirements, illustrative workflow, and editable resources for residential design professionals.

- [Free interior design templates](https://openlintel.com/templates/): Download editable interior design questionnaires, briefs, proposals, schedules, and budget spreadsheets with blank templates and illustrative examples.
- [Book an OpenLintel demo](https://openlintel.com/pilot/): Book an OpenLintel demo and discuss your residential design documentation, specification changes, and handoff workflow. The project is in active development.

- [How OpenLintel resources are made and reviewed](https://openlintel.com/editorial-policy/): Our approach to illustrative examples, AI assistance, evidence, corrections, and professional review of interior design resources.
- [Privacy and analytics choices](https://openlintel.com/privacy/): How OpenLintel handles Google sign-in, hosted project data, AI requests, optional website analytics, and privacy choices.
